title: Sabine Wren
description: Sabine Wren was many things: an accomplished artist, a Mandalorian warrior, and a rebel hero. It didn't matter that she lacked the latent Force ability of a Jedi, she was determined to learn the ways of the Force from Ahsoka Tano. Committed to finding Ezra Bridger and keeping the New Republic safe from Grand Admiral Thrawn, Sabine begrudgingly accompanied Morgan Elsbeth to the world of Seatos.
